visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a split screen; the top half features a white and gray cat with a wide-eyed, surprised expression, while the bottom half shows a man with dark hair wearing a black textured jacket, speaking directly to the camera in a studio setting with soft lighting. (2) A graphic of a generic blue and white website appears as the man continues to speak and gesticulate with his hands. (3) A graphic of a milk-style glass bottle labeled 'Italian Mountain Air' replaces the top half, followed by a brief shot of a young boy in a blue shirt sleeping on a couch, before a red 'Sold' stamp appears over the bottle graphic. (4) An outline of a unicorn made of dashed lines labeled 'Invisible Unicorn' is shown, and the man points toward it while explaining. (5) An image of an open cardboard box is displayed, followed by a yellow book titled 'Care Guide' with bulleted text, and then a red 'Sold' stamp appears over the unicorn outline again. (6) A text-based product listing titled 'My Soul' is shown above a shot of a middle-aged man in a blue shirt looking distressed, which is then covered by a large red 'X' mark. (7) The screen transitions to a promotional segment for Shopee, showing the mobile app interface, a yellow branded bag, and a series of screen recordings demonstrating how to upload videos and join a profit-sharing program. (8) The man returns to the main frame, gesturing with his palms open while explaining a point, before a purple card graphic with the text 'I give my soul to you' appears with a 'Sold' stamp. (9) The man concludes by looking directly into the lens with a slight smile and a questioning gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, upbeat electronic music track accompanied by a bright 'pop' sound effect as graphics appear. The male speaker introduces the topic of weird e-commerce items with a fast, clear, and excited tone. (2) A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the visual shifts to the bottle graphic; the speaker's pitch rises slightly to emphasize the absurdity of selling air. (3) A soft 'ding' sound accompanies the appearance of the 'Sold' stamp, followed by a series of quick 'bubble pop' effects for subsequent item reveals. (4) During the Shopee promotion, a series of digital UI 'clicks' and 'taps' are audible, synchronized with the app navigation on screen; the speaker maintains a persuasive and friendly narrative tone. (5) As the explanation for the soul listing's removal is given, the music maintains its steady tempo while the speaker uses a slightly lower, more informative pitch. (6) A final 'ping' sound effect marks the appearance of the 'Sold' stamp on the soul card, followed by the speaker's concluding question with a rising intonation.
